opportunity.summary: Hitachi is looking for FY 2025–26 BBA/MBA freshers to join its Services team as a Project Coordinator Associate.
opportunity.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic FY 2025–26 BBA/MBA freshers to join our Services team.

A Project Coordinator supports project managers by coordinating daily activities, tracking progress, maintaining documentation, and facilitating communication.
responsibilities: Assist in project planning, scheduling, and administration.
Coordinate meetings, prepare minutes, and track action items.
Monitor tasks and update project timelines.
Maintain project documentation and status reports.
Communicate with team members, stakeholders, and clients.
Ensure required tools, access, and resources are available to the team.
opportunity.importantNote: This is a specific fresher hiring requirement, and no employee referral bonus will be applicable for this position.
